annotation.summary: Shared monitor validator (validateMonitor): the single accept/reject gate for monitor configuration, called by the write routes and reused inside a versioned saved-object migration.
assumptions: Propagation review: upstream contracts unchanged; integrationPoints still accurate.

risks.text: validateMonitor is a shared validator a released saved-object migration runs unchanged; any edit here — including one behind a flag or default — couples the change to that frozen consumer, so a not-yet-migrated monitor can fail to load. Treat it as a stable contract, not an extension point.

invariants: validateMonitor is called on the monitor write paths and also inside a versioned saved-object migration.
That migration throws when validateMonitor returns invalid, so the function itself is a migration-stability contract: it is consumed unchanged by a released migration.

annotation.summary: Versioned saved-object migration for monitors (8.8.0): drops zip-url fields, then re-validates each monitor via validateMonitor and throws on failure.
assumptions: Propagation review: upstream contracts unchanged; integrationPoints still accurate.

risks.text: Editing this migration, or the validateMonitor it runs, re-transforms or re-rejects documents already migrated under 8.8.0 — a saved-object stability regression.

invariants: A released migration's output and accept/reject behavior are frozen: an un-migrated monitor (snapshot restore, rolling upgrade) must migrate the same way it always did.
It reuses the runtime validateMonitor; changes to that validator change this migration's behavior.
